default_guidance: Upload documents in the Maple Grove patient portal under Documents, or bring them to the front desk. Photos are fine if every corner and all text is readable.

category_guidance.sick_visit: For a same day sick visit, the front desk needs your insurance on file before the visit is billed.
category_guidance.physical: For a physical, preventive care is usually covered in full, but extra tests can carry a cost.

document_guidance.photo of your current insurance card: Send a photo of the front and back of your current insurance card. The member ID, the group number, and the plan name must be readable.

document_alternatives.default: If you don't have the document, the front desk can help when you're at the clinic.
document_alternatives.photo of your current insurance card: If you don't have the card with you, the front desk can look up your plan with your member ID and date of birth.

followup_settings.human_review_rule: If the documents aren't available, the front desk reviews your account by hand.

followup_rules.text: If you don't have {documents} with you, the front desk can look up your plan for visit {record_id}.
Please send {documents} before you're called back for visit {record_id}, so billing goes to the right plan.
Bills usually update in the portal within {processing_time} after insurance responds.
Upload {documents} in the patient portal under Documents, or hand it to the front desk.

followup_fallback: I don't have a specific answer for that. The front desk can help, or I can tell you what's on file for this visit.
